critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: startup() sequentially generates 3 gpt-image-1 avatars (~15s each) → ~45s cold-start; occasional 502 during hot-reload while startup finishes. Consider async gather or lazy generation.
Non-blocking: server.py now 1186 lines - approaching 700-line split threshold; suggest splitting into routers (chat.py, knowledge.py, admin.py, avatar.py).
Non-blocking: crawl endpoint stores extracted products under 'catalog' key on user doc but the POST response returns them under 'products' key - fine but slightly inconsistent naming.
Non-blocking: Voice-call greeting message is added twice ('Voice call started. Just talk — I'll listen.' + 'Voice call ended.') in the transcript panel - fine for UX but could reset per session.
Non-blocking: crawl uses static requests.get (no JS render); worked for apple.com/shop/buy-iphone this time but JS-heavy shops may return empty catalog - consider Playwright/browserless fallback.
